### Added

- *(model-manager)* Accept backend lemonade — a Lemonade Server (FastFlowLM on AMD Ryzen AI NPUs, llama.cpp) as the second host-proxying backend: lemonade.{endpoint, agentHost} in the model-manager block, the render guard, and network-policy egress to its endpoint in both flavors in [#261](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/261) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
